name: SubHarm
description: Subharmonicon-inspired polyrhythmic chord voice for NTS-3. Hold the pad to run two 4-step sequencers clocked by layered rhythm divisions; six tones (2 VCOs + 4 integer subs) feed a soft ladder-ish LPF. X = polyrhythm density, Y = subharmonic mix.

params.name: POLY
params.detail: How many rhythm divisions clock the sequencers

params.name: SUBS
params.detail: Level of the four subharmonic oscillators

params.name: ROOT
params.detail: Root note for the chord engine

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Amp envelope decay after each step
